RUNEPRIEST-INSCRIBE.title: Inscribe
RUNEPRIEST-INSCRIBE.description: Add a glyph to the end of your Incantation. If it matches the glyph before it, they merge and their values add up. At the end of your turn it is [gold]Spoken[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-SPEAK.title: Speak
RUNEPRIEST-SPEAK.description: Resolve your Incantation from left to right, then clear it. Glyphs that make no sense fizzle harmlessly.
RUNEPRIEST-INCANTATION_SCRIPT.title: Current Incantation
RUNEPRIEST-OVERFLOW.title: Overflow
RUNEPRIEST-OVERFLOW.description: When your Incantation is full, the oldest glyph is [gold]Spoken[/gold] on its own immediately.
RUNEPRIEST-FORECAST.title: Forecast
RUNEPRIEST-FORECAST.note: [color=#a0a0a0]Base values; Strength, Vulnerable, etc. not included.[/color]
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_VENOM.title: Venom
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SANCTIFY.title: Sanctify
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SANCTIFY.description: [blue]Blood[/blue] runes in the next glyph have no effect. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], protects the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_STRIKE.title: Strike
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_WARD.title: Ward
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_WARD.description: Grant {Value} [gold]Block[/gold] to the target ally (you, by default).
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND.title: Mend
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND.description: Heal the target ally (you, by default) for {Value} HP.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_BLOOD.title: Blood
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_KINDLE.title: Kindle
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_KINDLE.description: Gain {Value} [gold]Energy[/gold] next turn, or now if Spoken mid-turn. Not affected by [blue]Amplify[/blue] or [blue]Twin[/blue].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_INSIGHT.title: Insight
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_INSIGHT.description: Draw {Value} cards next turn, or now if Spoken mid-turn. Not affected by [blue]Amplify[/blue] or [blue]Twin[/blue].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_HEX.title: Hex
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_EXPOSE.title: Expose
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_AMPLIFY.title: Amplify
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_AMPLIFY.description: The next glyph's values gain {Value}. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], empowers the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_TWIN.title: Twin
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_TWIN.description: Multiply the next glyph's values by {Value}. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], empowers the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ECHO.title: Echo
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ECHO.description: Resolve the next glyph {Value} extra time(s). Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], multiplies its repetitions.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ANCHOR.title: Anchor
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ANCHOR.description: Later runes affect the creature chosen when their card was played. This is the default.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEEK.title: Seek
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEEK.description: Later runes pick a random target each time.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_NOVA.title: Nova
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_NOVA.description: Later runes affect ALL enemies, or all allies for supportive runes.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CHAIN.title: Chain
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CHAIN.description: Later runes cycle through targets in order.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CULL.title: Cull
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CULL.description: Later runes target whoever has the lowest HP.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MIRROR.title: Mirror
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MIRROR.description: Later offensive runes hit YOU, and supportive runes aid an enemy. Any other targeting rune ends the Mirror.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_LOOP.title: Loop
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_LOOP.description: Repeat the glyphs up to the next [blue]End Loop[/blue] {Value} times. An unclosed Loop runs to the end.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_END_LOOP.title: End Loop
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEAL.title: Seal
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEAL.description: Stop Speaking. Glyphs after the Seal wait until next turn.
